name: Aquarium Tank
summary: A brand-neutral glass aquarium on a low cabinet, with transparent water, sand substrate, procedural rocks and aquatic plants, clear lids and a light bar. No fish included; a central anchor and clear swim volume are reserved for separate placement.
description: A brand-neutral glass aquarium on a low cabinet, with transparent water, sand substrate, procedural rocks and aquatic plants, clear lids and a light bar. No fish included; a central anchor and clear swim volume are reserved for separate placement.
author: Yap Wei Jun project / agent-assisted procedural modeling
creation_method: Original deterministic Blender Python geometry and vertex colours, seed 5283. No external assets, textures, fonts, brands or lettering.
origin: Floor centre of the cabinet; local glTF Y=0 is the floor datum.

fish_placement.purpose: Intended origin for a separately supplied and scaled koi. No fish or fish animation included. Fit the entire fish and its motion envelope inside the reserved bounds; placement is not an animal-care recommendation.
fish_placement.clearance_test: Actual exported opaque triangles do not intersect the reserved axis-aligned swim volume.

material_notes: Three shared materials: an opaque vertex-colour palette, pale glass alpha BLEND 0.035, aqua water alpha BLEND 0.07. No textures or refraction/transmission pass. Water is static; the diffuser is visual geometry, with no exported light.
accuracy_notes: Original visual aquarium, not an engineering or animal-husbandry specification. Transparent surfaces use lightweight alpha blending with renderer-dependent sorting. Full-mall performance, physical Android/iOS and WebKit are not verified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural geometry, vertex colours and materials. No external assets.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
